fullDescription: A high-impact, dark-mode mobile interface designed for real-time reporting and disaster monitoring. Features a bold red and orange gradient accent system against a deep obsidian background (#0a0608). The aesthetic blends technical data visualization with editorial typography (Clash Grotesk & Satoshi). Suitable for fintech dashboards, emergency response apps, security monitors, or any platform requiring high-visibility status updates and severity-based categorization. Key elements include seismic grid backgrounds, scanline flickering effects, and staggered fade-up animations.

structured.summary: A vibrant, data-heavy mobile dashboard utilizing high-contrast severity color-coding, technical typography, and a 'living' UI with pulse animations and scanlines.

style.description: The style is 'Neobrutalist Tech'. It relies on a dark base (#0a0608) with electric red (#ff2d55) and orange (#ff6a00) accents. Typography pairs the high-character 'Clash Grotesk' for headings and 'Satoshi' for functional UI text. Visual depth is created via radial glows, a subtle 28px seismic grid, and animated scanlines.
style.prompt: Create a high-contrast dark mobile UI using a base background of #0a0608. Use 'Clash Grotesk' for bold, heavy headings and 'Satoshi' for body text. Primary accent: #ff2d55; Secondary accent: #ff6a00; Tertiary (moderate): #f5c518. Background effects must include a repeating grid of 1px lines at 28px intervals in #ff2d550a and a fixed vertical scanline moving across the screen. Buttons and active states should use a linear gradient from #ff2d55 to #ff6a00 with a 0 4px 24px rgba(255,45,85,0.55) glow. Cards use #130b0e with 1.5px borders in #2e1520. Use staggered fade-up entry animations for all components.

layout_and_structure.description: Mobile-first vertical scroll with a fixed top header and a floating-style bottom navigation bar. Content is organized into severity-ranked sections with summary stats at the top.

prompts.prompt: At the top, place a 'Reports.' title in 26px Clash Grotesk Bold. Beside it, include a 'Live' pill (#ff2d551f) with a pulsing red dot. Below the title, include a full-width search bar with background #1a0d11, 12px rounded corners, and a search icon. Beneath the search bar, provide a horizontally scrollable row of 'Filter Chips'. Active chip: #ff2d55 gradient; Inactive: #1a0d11 background with #2e1520 border.

A flex-row of 4 equal-width mini-cards. Each card has a #130b0e background, 12px border radius, a 10px uppercase label in #6b3345, and a large 22px Clash Grotesk number colored by status (Red, Orange, Yellow, White).
Display alerts grouped by severity headings (e.g., 'Critical Alerts'). Each section starts with a 11px uppercase label in #6b3345 with 0.12em letter spacing. List items are alert cards.

Card layout: #130b0e background, 16px radius, 1px border #2e1520. Left edge features a 4px vertical severity bar (Red/Orange/Yellow). Inside, a top-row with a 36px icon box, event title, and location. To the right, a large 'Magnitude/Wind' value (28px Clash Grotesk). Below this, a row of badges for depth, signal level, or timestamp. The card can expand to show a detail panel with map-pin icons, specific coordinates, and an SVG sparkline representing a seismic waveform in #ff2d55.

A fixed bottom bar in #0e080b with a 1px top border. Include 4 icons (Home, Reports, People, Settings). The active tab must be highlighted with #ff2d55 and a small label in 10px uppercase Satoshi. Provide generous bottom padding (28px) for mobile safe areas.

special_ui_components.description: A technical visualization of data within the card detail.
special_ui_components.prompt: An SVG path stroke in #ff2d55 with 1.5px width. The path should mimic an erratic heartbeat monitor or seismic activity. Set opacity to 0.5. Container includes a 10px subtitle 'SEISMIC WAVEFORM · PHIVOLCS DATA' in #6b3345.
A rounded-full container with background rgba(255,45,85,0.12) and 1px border rgba(255,45,85,0.3). Contains an 8px circular dot with a 1.4s infinite blink animation and a 0 0 8px #ff2d55 glow effect.
